01THE THESIS

A skill is a procedure.
A schema is a promise.

Voyager turns successful Minecraft behavior into reusable, executable skills. That is powerful, but a skill alone can be brittle: it knows what to replay, not which assumptions made it safe.

SchemaVoyager adds an explicit world model. Every mining and crafting rule carries preconditions, an exact predicted effect, and evidence from logged steps. The agent plans with those promises, checks each one as it acts, and demotes the one that breaks.

02THE LOOP

From observation
to reusable behavior.

Click through one episode. The agent does not just remember a transcript; it keeps rules it can check and skills that say which rules they rely on.

05THE CURRICULUM

          

            
Small world.
Changed rules.
Every task starts from an empty inventory in a walled arena with three oak trees and a stone patch with exposed coal. Training runs on layouts 1 and 2; the holdout runs on layouts 6 to 8 with one loot table changed by a datapack the client can never see.
